args.body: Take NZ-GETS-DATA-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT under a valid lease. The queued FETCH is the official GETS entry page and counts as the initial discovery attempt. Verify whether it actually exposes current notices or a first-party open-opportunities feed. If it only links to a feed, you may use one of the two remaining GETs for that feed and reserve the other for the strongest original notice. Prioritize the executed buyer-specific sample and operator response if eligibility and the response route are evidenced. A generic page or failed retrieval leaves market coverage unknown.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The feedback snapshot has zero classified requests, five unclassified sources and ten skips, so SQLite demand remains unknown. Keep the site online while ACQUISITION closes the measurement checkpoint from committed evidence. Independently, test a buyer-led route through a New Zealand procurement feed. Advance only if an original notice establishes a live, separately quotable task and a permitted response route. The catalogue example remains available offline while release ownership and provenance are resolved. Public deployment still requires host-enforced review of the exact digest.
